title: Old Zurich War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Old Zurich War", at revision 1370630437, opens: "The Old Zurich War was a conflict between the canton of Zurich and the other seven cantons of the Old Swiss Confederacy over the succession to the Count of Toggenburg." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q438252, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
